plain.li: [trait:Tough] Cold night. I've slept in worse, but not by much.
[trait:Wimp] So cold last night my teeth chattered until I bit my tongue.
[old] The cold settles in my joints now. This morning I couldn't close my hand until noon.
[snow] Snow blew in under the door in the night and drifted against my bed.
[lowtech] The fire went out before midnight. I lay there telling myself to get up and feed it, and didn't.
[!lowtech] The heater in our room clicked off around midnight and never came back on.
[hurt] The cold got into my wound last night. It ached until morning.
[trait:NightOwl] Too cold to sleep, so I worked through the night to keep warm.
[hot] Too hot to sleep and too hot to work. I don't know which is worse.
[trait:Tough] Hot night. Slept anyway.
[old] The heat makes my heart race at night. I sat up by the door until it cooled.
[lowtech] Slept outside on a mat to get away from the heat inside. The mosquitoes found me there.
[!lowtech] Can't sleep in this heat. Someone needs to look at the cooler in our room.
[winter] Short days and long work. I'm tired before the sun goes down.
[trait:NightOwl] Morning work again. I'm useless before noon, and today proved it.
[trait:Industrious] Worked until I couldn't see straight. I'll be up early to finish.
[trait:HardWorker] Tired to the bone, but the job's done.
[trait:Lazy] So tired. I was on my feet almost the whole morning.
[trait:Slothful] Tired, as always. I lay down twice today and got told off both times.
[old] I tire faster than I used to. Sat down at noon and woke up an hour later.
[teen] They want me up at dawn every day. I'd sleep until noon if they let me.
[afterraid] Haven't slept properly since the attack. Every noise wakes me.
[hurt] My body's trying to heal and I keep making it work. Tired all over.
[trait:Ascetic] Hungry today. It clears the head, up to a point.
[poor] Not enough food to go around. I gave half my bowl back.
[afterraid] No one's cooked since the fight. We ate whatever was in reach.
[old] I don't need as much food as I used to, but today I didn't get even that.
[teen] Starving. I ate my lunch at breakfast and had nothing at lunch.
[hurt] Hungry, and too sore to walk to the kitchen.
[winter] Long winter evenings and nothing to fill them.
[rain] Raining all day, so I sat and watched it. That was my fun for the day.
[trait:TooSmart] I've read every book we have twice. I've started correcting them in the margins.
[skill:Artistic] Nothing to do, so I drew the others at supper on the back of an old sack.
[trait:Industrious] An evening with nothing to do. I found some work instead.
[teen] Nothing to do here, and no one my age to do it with.
[lowtech] Not even a pair of dice in the place. I listened to the fire crackle until I fell asleep.
[!lowtech] Sat in front of the television without really watching it.
[trait:Wimp] {OTHER_nameDef} said I was brave to go out there today. I don't feel brave, but I liked hearing it.
[trait:Ugly] {OTHER_nameDef} said I have kind eyes. I've never been told that before.
[newcomer] {OTHER_nameDef} told me I'm fitting in well here. I hope it's true.
[lowmood] {OTHER_nameDef} said something kind when I needed it. I don't think {OTHER_pronoun} knew how much.
[old] {OTHER_nameDef} said I still have the steadiest hands in the colony. At my age that means something.
[teen] {OTHER_nameDef} said I did the work of a grown-up today. I acted like it didn't matter.
[trait:NightOwl] People stomping around all morning while I was trying to sleep.
[trait:Nervous] Every footstep in the night sounded like someone coming for me. I barely closed my eyes.
[trait:Volatile] If I'm woken one more night, I'll say something I can't take back.
[old] I sleep light now, and they're never quiet. Up three times last night.
[storm] Thunder half the night, and people up checking the roof the other half.
[afterraid] People were up all night checking the walls after the fight. I don't blame them, but I didn't sleep.
[trait:Recluse] Another night in a room full of people. I lay with my face to the wall until morning.
[trait:Ascetic] The barracks suit me. A bed is a bed.
[trait:Greedy] The others have rooms of their own, and I sleep in a row with whoever else they couldn't be bothered to house.
[trait:Jealous] Walked past someone's bedroom on my way to the barracks. Their door was open and they had a rug.
[old] I'm too old to be sleeping in a row like a recruit.
[teen] The barracks are full of snoring grown-ups. I'd rather sleep in the barn.
[winter] At least the barracks stay warm in winter, with so many of us breathing.
[lowtech] Slept in the longhouse again, the lot of us in a row on the furs.
[newcomer] First nights in the barracks. I don't know whose snoring is whose yet.
[trait:Ascetic] The dining room is too grand for me. I ate quickly and went back out.
[trait:Greedy] The good dining room is the one place here that feels like it suits me.
[trait:Gourmand] Food tastes better on a good table. I had three helpings to be sure.
[skill:Artistic] Studied the sculpture in the dining room all through supper. I'd like to try one like it.
[old] A proper table and proper chairs. I've waited my whole life for a dining room like this.
[lowtech] The great hall was warm tonight, with the long table full and the fire high.
[winter] The dining room's the warmest place in the colony on a winter night. None of us wanted to leave.
[trait:Undergrounder] Dark rooms don't bother me. The others keep stumbling about, though.
[trait:NightOwl] Worked in the dark and liked it. The quiet suits me.
[trait:Nervous] I don't like the dark back rooms. Something always moves just out of sight.
[winter] It's dark by midafternoon in winter, and dark again before breakfast.
[old] My eyes aren't good enough for these dark rooms. I've started counting my steps.
[skill:Crafting] Can't do fine work without light. I botched a seam I could have done in my sleep.
[trait:Greedy] Wearing rags while the stores are full of cloth. I've noticed.
[trait:Ascetic] My clothes are worn, but they still keep the rain off.
[skill:Crafting] My coat's falling apart. I'll make my own if the tailor doesn't get to it.
[trait:Pretty|trait:Beautiful] I can't bear to be seen in these rags.
[rain] The rain comes straight through the holes in my coat.
[old] I've had this coat longer than some of the others have been alive. It's showing.
[trait:Ascetic] No table again. I don't mind. Food tastes the same on the floor.
[trait:Greedy] Eating off the floor like a servant. I didn't come here for this.
[old] Getting down to sit on the floor is the hard part. Getting up again is worse.
[rain] Ate in the rain under the eaves, holding my bowl close.
[lowtech] Ate squatting next to the cookfire with my bowl in my lap, the same as the others.
[hurt] Ate on the floor, with my bad side propped against the wall.
[rain] It rained all day, and I worked in it all day.
[rain] Rain dripping off my hood and down the back of my neck since morning.
[trait:Tough] Soaked through. Didn't slow me down.
[trait:Wimp] I got soaked, and now I think I'm getting sick.
[old] Wet clothes and old bones don't mix. I'll feel this tomorrow.
[skill:Plants] Spent the day in the wet fields. The crops loved it, at least.
[trait:Tough] Hurts. Doesn't matter. Worked anyway.
[trait:Wimp] It hurts so much. I spent the day lying down and still couldn't stop shaking.
[trait:Masochist] The pain today was almost pleasant. I didn't tell the doctor that.
[old] Old wounds and new ones, all aching together.
[afterraid] Still hurting from the fight. The doctor says I was lucky.
[skill:Medicine] I know exactly what's wrong and exactly how long it'll take. Knowing doesn't help.
[winter] The cold makes the pain worse. I keep my arm close to the fire.
[lowtech] Played dice in the hall after supper. Lost two arrows and won one back.
[lowtech] Someone brought out the drums tonight. I danced until I couldn't feel my feet.
[trait:TooSmart] Won every game of chess tonight. Tomorrow I'll have to play against myself.
[trait:Recluse] Went to the games room late, when it was empty, and had the place to myself.
[skill:Social] Spent the evening in the games room getting the quiet ones talking.
[old] Taught the young ones an old card game. They cheat worse than I did at their age.
[teen] Spent all evening in the rec room. Somebody said I was hogging the table.
[spring] Planted the first seeds today. Everything around us is green and waking up.
[summer] Long warm days and a lot of land. Hard to complain.
[fall] We've arrived late in the year. We'll need to work fast, but we'll manage.
[winter] A hard season to start in. Still, we have a roof over part of us.
[tribal] We set the first stones of our camp and asked the spirits to watch over them.
[medieval] Drove the first stake of the palisade today, and we cheered.
[spacer] Solid ground under my feet and real air. After the ship, this is a palace.
[old] I've started over more times than I can count. My knees remember every one.
